chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan ibn Yahya from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm if all the rituals are performed without wudu, except for the Tawaf, for indeed it includes salat, and wudu is superior."
ai.seo_question: Is wudu required for Tawaf during Hajj according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling to clarify the distinction between obligatory purity (wajib) and recommended purity (mustahabb) in Hajj rituals. While most acts like Sa'i do not strictly require wudu, Tawaf is treated as a prayer (salat) where wudu is highly preferred (afdal) rather than mandatory, reflecting the juristic view that Tawaf carries the spiritual weight of prayer.
